_source_vllm: MEASURED 2026-07-27 on dgx.casa (GB10): `du -sk -L ~/venvs/vllm-oracle` = 9899580 KiB total; component sizes from `du -sk site-packages/*`. This is the pinned parity oracle venv (vLLM 0.26.0.dev0, built from source for sm_121a).
_source_ours: MEASURED 2026-07-27 on the dev box: build-demo/examples/server, CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release, CPU backend, stripped = 10330088 bytes. The server links libvllm.a statically (ldd shows no libvllm dependency), so this single file is the whole deployment.
_caveat: NOT a like-for-like build pairing: the vLLM figure is a CUDA-enabled venv, ours is a CPU Release build. A CUDA build of vllm.cpp embeds device code and is larger; that figure is not yet measured and is deliberately not estimated here. The caveat is drawn on the card.
